items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: This is the O'Day-Jean Black Diamond Orchestra, 1928 the picture says.

ctx.x: Oh, when I taken this, I had a tuba. I started that in 28 with this. Let's see. Which tour was that? With this band. I don't forget his name. He was a, I think he was a foreigner too. He was from British Honduras. I just remember his first name. Now this is the band caused me to have a tuba.
This is the O'Day-Jean Black Diamond Orchestra, 1928 the picture says. Can you tell us who the members of that are? That's Eddie Pearson.
Oh, Standing in Back, in the Dark Coat. That's Leo Dejean.
